releases.notes:
Fozzie now requires sign-in: anonymous access is refused, and existing agents are moved into the right group automatically when you update. New permissions tools let admins see who has access to anything and why, check what someone can do, manage authority groups, and revoke or edit grants, with a guard against removing the last admin. Also fixes the page scrolling bug and literal backticks around inline code.

Agent sessions can now run for 40 minutes (was 20), so long test runs and reviews stop parking work. Includes the Security sweep 3 dependency upgrades (Prisma 7, Express 5, graphql-yoga 6, TypeScript 6), browser session expiry, a fix for the publish build, and a clearer installer message when old data is left with no .env.
